test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18abe023a97924bb63102176b7f07aa57e799a5a2e2b4e72e7cf39068735c3e9.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) Arrow in the box rotates anti-clockwise direction and becomes light and dark alternate.

2) Star rotate clockwise direction in a box in each corner.

3) Dark square rotates clockwise direction in a box in each corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edf8bbeafb7200e993f97ae9040611ac5bea44a64ea1b55831f04cb85babe99a.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4b590e082bc0620ce93e571f544e13a70a9f27887968d8ecbf07e71626675e7.png] 

Hence, **‘option 3’** is the correct answer.
